entries.what: Walks to Flats High for the first day of semester midterms and sits her APUSH exam. After school she studies at the library homework center until close.
entries.outcome: One midterm done, a long study list left.

entries.what: Eats dinner at home with Grace, Lola Cora and Ramón, does the dishes, then studies in her bed until late.
entries.outcome: Dinner stays civil; the dishes get done.

entries.what: Takes a physics midterm in the morning. Her AP Chem unit test is Friday, so she studies stoichiometry at the library in the afternoon and spends the evening on practice problems. She is not coasting; the test is just days away.
entries.outcome: Makes a plan for the chem test and works through problems.

entries.what: Goes to robotics after school for the mechanical subteam, then walks home. She checks on Lola Cora, who has had her lunch.
Takes an AP Calc midterm, then goes to Kessler Middle for Wednesday tutoring. Mateo shows her a better quiz grade in fractions and ratios.
entries.outcome: Mateo's improved quiz makes her happy.

entries.what: Plans a small game to celebrate Mateo's quiz grade, with ratio cards and a prize of a sticker. She is gentle and patient in how she describes it.
Does her dishes after dinner and studies for her chem test until midnight.
Takes an AP Lang midterm. At lunch Nadia tells her about a rough yearbook day.
Attends robotics from 3:30 to 6 in room C7 and works the drivetrain with her subteam.
Late at night she asks the assistant about sleep before big tests and says she wants only facts, not advice.
entries.outcome: Gets a short list of numbers.

entries.what: Takes the AP Chem unit test and her last midterm. Afterward she gets jasmine milk tea with Nadia at Cloud Nine.
Spends the evening at home. Ramón is on shift, so she makes sure Lola Cora ate and watches a film with the score on.
Goes to the Saturday morning library session, then helps Lola Cora and Father Ben with the Thanksgiving food drive at Our Lady of the Marsh.
entries.outcome: Hands out turkeys and groceries for several hours.

entries.what: Returns home and rests, then visits Nadia's house at curfew time and gets back by 10 p.m.
Looks through her marsh bird photos and the tally notebook from last weekend's count.
Goes to Tagalog Mass with Grace and Lola Cora, then eats the Sunday sinigang.
entries.outcome: Eats two bowls and pretends to be indifferent.

entries.what: Grace grades midterms at the table while Isabel works on her Mom sheet and finishes homework. Ramón comes home from his shift.
Goes to bed near 1 a.m. with the Bronco visible from her window.
